claims.claim_text: At Army entry on 1942-10-28, George S. Breitmayer Jr. was coded in the student category; no school was named.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army record carries the raw student code, and NARA's compiled list defines that code as students.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact private-identifier agreement confirms that the Army record belongs to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry, but the code does not supply a school or complete civilian chronology.
claims.match_notes: Student status is not employment and does not displace the separately documented company employment.

claims.claim_text: George S. Breitmayer Jr.'s last documented civilian employer before Army service was Cleveland Electric Motor Company in Lakewood, Ohio.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The library biography says that after high school he worked for Cleveland Electric Motor Company and entered the Army on October 28, 1942.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed indexed identity through exact private identifier, with matching name, suffix, Army-entry date, and later OSS service in the institutional biography.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded as the last documented civilian employer before Army entry. Army service intervened before OSS, so it is not labeled immediate pre-OSS.
claims.match_notes: The source does not give a role title or prove the exact final workday; neither is inferred.
